title: Agentic Engineering Patterns: Subagents
description: Simon Willison explores subagents as a pattern for handling larger tasks with LLMs without burning through too much context. Subagents provide a way to work around context window limitations by spawning specialized agents for specific tasks.
author: Simon Willison

title: Introducing Mistral Small 4
description: New Apache 2 licensed 119B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from Mistral that unifies capabilities of Magistral (reasoning), Pixtral (multimodal), and Devstral (agentic coding) into a single model. Supports reasoning_effort parameter.
author: Simon Willison

title: OpenAI Codex Subagents Now Generally Available
description: OpenAI Codex announces general availability of subagents (similar to Claude Code), with default agents for 'explorer', 'worker', and 'default'. Also supports custom agents defined as TOML files with specific model assignments.
author: Simon Willison

title: Coding Agents for Data Analysis - NICAR 2026 Workshop
description: Simon Willison's workshop handout for using Claude Code and OpenAI Codex for data journalism. Covers database queries, data exploration, cleaning, visualization, and web scraping. Participants used $23 of Codex tokens in a 3-hour session.
author: Simon Willison

title: arXiv cs.AI Recent Submissions March 11-17, 2026
description: ArXiv's artificial intelligence category shows continued research activity with submissions covering explainable AI (XAI), machine learning advances, and novel AI architectures. 684 total papers on March 11 alone including 189 AI papers and 68 NLP papers.
author: arXiv

title: 7 New Open Source AI Tools You Need Right Now
description: Fireship video covering 7 new open source AI tools for developers. Focus on AI infrastructure for managing agents rather than just chatbots or copilots. Covers latest AI coding tools and developer workflows.
author: Fireship

title: Meta Plans $115 Billion AI Investment in 2026
description: Reddit discussion from r/MistralAI about Meta's planned $115 billion AI spending in 2026 alone. Comparison with other AI company funding: OpenAI $58B, Anthropic $37B. Shows massive scale of AI investment.
author: Reddit Community

title: Claude Code Founder's 2026 Predictions for Software Engineers
description: Reddit discussion from r/ClaudeAI about Anthropic's Claude Code creator predicting significant shifts in software engineer roles by 2026. Mentions 'crazy' AI developments expected and engineers taking on tasks beyond coding.
author: Reddit Community

title: 1M Context Now Generally Available for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6
description: Anthropic extends 1M token context to Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 with standard pricing across the full window - no long-context premium, unlike competitors (Gemini and GPT-5.4 charge more after certain thresholds).
author: Simon Willison

title: Shopify Liquid Performance: 53% Faster Using Autoresearch
description: Tobias Lütke used Andrej Karpathy's autoresearch pattern to achieve 53% performance improvement in Shopify's Liquid template engine. Ran 120 automated experiments over 93 commits. Illustrates how coding agents + robust test suites enable automated performance research.
author: Simon Willison

title: Why AI Still Can't Replace Developers in 2026
description: Reddit discussion from r/ClaudeCode with developers using AI and LLMs daily for development and AI agent creation. Explores limitations of AI even in 2026 context and discusses human-AI collaboration.
author: Reddit Community

title: Coding After Coders: The End of Computer Programming as We Know It
description: New York Times Magazine piece by Clive Thompson featuring insights from 70+ developers. Simon Willison quoted on how coding has unique advantage of being able to test AI output for correctness, unlike law or other fields.
author: Simon Willison

title: The 2026 Coding AI Breakthrough, Explained in 4 Minutes
description: Quick breakdown of the 2026 generative coding AI breakthrough that is reshaping software development. Explains key advances in AI coding capabilities.
author: AI Explained

title: Sorting Algorithms Visualizer Built with Claude Artifacts
description: Simon Willison built interactive sorting algorithm visualizations using Claude Artifacts, including Timsort implementation by cloning CPython repository. Demonstrates 'vibe coding' - iteratively improving visualizations through conversation.
author: Simon Willison

title: A Universal Nearest-Neighbor Estimator for Intrinsic Dimensionality
description: ArXiv paper (cs.LG) submitted March 11, 2026, presenting a universal nearest-neighbor estimator for intrinsic dimensionality. Advances in machine learning theory and estimation methods.
author: ArXiv Researchers
